text:
Caroline: quick heads-up — ran the quantized v2 model across us-east/us-west/eu-west with the new edge-path split (70/30). summary below, noticing a big p95 gap in us-west. attaching raw numbers.
Caroline:```
region   | gpu  | p50(ms) | p95(ms) | qps | cache_hit
us-east  | H100 | 30      | 110     | 520 | 92%
us-west  | H100 | 33      | 210     | 480 | 78%
eu-west  | H100 | 31      | 115     | 500 | 90%
us-east  | A100 | 38      | 122     | 430 | 90%
us-west  | A100 | 44      | 220     | 360 | 75%
eu-west  | A100 | 41      | 130     | 88% (typo?)
```
Caroline: full run at https://bench.internal/runs/1943210000 :eyes:

Raj: that us-west p95 on both H100/A100 is worrying. were there fallback routes or cross-pop egress during the test?

Caroline: yes we enabled edge fallback to central-pop for cold prefixes (30% fallback). idea was to smooth cold-start load. fallback looks correlated with higher p95.

Evan: could be KV-cache warmup + extra hop. us-west cache_hit 75-78% vs us-east 90% — fallback hits central which adds ~80-120ms tail.

Sophie: also check kernel selection on us-west workers. I saw some nodes picking `custom_cuda_v2` vs `aten_fused` after quantization. one kernel path drops into slower memcpy for quantized attention.

Caroline: good call — I'll dump kernel tags from the run. quick snippet from logs:

Caroline:```
[worker-23] kernel_path=custom_cuda_v2 quantized=4bit seq_len=1024
[worker-47] kernel_path=aten_fused quantized=4bit seq_len=1024
[worker-23] fallback_to_cpu=false, remote_pop=central-us
```

Raj: if worker-23 is on the us-west edge and doing remote_pop calls, that explains 200ms+ p95. remote_pop latency + slower quant kernel = tail.

Evan: actionable: (1) re-run with fallback off, (2) force `aten_fused` on a subset to compare, (3) collect prefix hit distribution per-pop. want to know if batching differences matter too.

ml-bench-bot: New graph uploaded — latency heatmaps + per-pop cache_hit: https://bench.internal/graphs/1943210000/heatmap

Caroline: I've queued the no-fallback run now (job 1943210012). will also set a control run forcing aten_fused on 10 nodes.

Sophie: will add a small runtime tweak to log kernel_name in trace spans so we can join traces > p95 quickly.

Raj: also add a sampling of long tail requests payloads (prompts) — want to rule out prompt-size skew.

Caroline: noted. rough timeline: control runs in ~30m, then compare p50/p95 deltas. if fallback is the culprit we should see us-west p95 drop to ~120ms.

Evan: thanks. if that fixes it we should update edge routing policy: reduce fallback for quantized models and prefer warm-up prefetch.

Caroline: agreed. will post results here. :thumbsup:

Sophie: ping me if you need a quick kernel toggle rollout — I can flip flags on the canary pool.

Caroline: thanks, team — will follow up with numbers.
